lyrics.ja: あの"星"は綺麗で
lyrics.en: That "star" is beautiful
lyrics.zh: 那一顆「星星」真美

lyrics.ja: 上ばかり見て走って
lyrics.en: Running while only looking up at the sky
lyrics.zh: 只顧昂首向前奔跑

lyrics.ja: そのたびにつまづいて
lyrics.en: Stumbling every single time
lyrics.zh: 每次都因而摔了跤

lyrics.ja: だけどそれも楽しくて
lyrics.en: But even that was so much fun
lyrics.zh: 但連那過程也無比歡樂

lyrics.ja: いつの間にか日は暮れて
lyrics.en: Before we noticed, the sun went down
lyrics.zh: 不知不覺間夕陽西下

lyrics.ja: 夕焼けに照らされた
lyrics.en: Illuminated by the sunset glow
lyrics.zh: 被晚霞所映照著

lyrics.ja: 君の目は輝いて
lyrics.en: Your eyes were shining brightly
lyrics.zh: 你的雙眼正熠熠生輝

lyrics.ja: 「まるで"星"みたいだね」
lyrics.en: "It's just like a 'star', isn't it?"
lyrics.zh: 「簡直就像是一顆『星星』呢」

lyrics.ja: 夢の続きみるために
lyrics.romaji: Yume no Tsuzuki Miru Tame ni
lyrics.en: Saying there's no time to sleep
lyrics.zh: 說著為了看夢境的續集

lyrics.ja: 眠る暇はないからって
lyrics.romaji: Nemuru Hima ha Nai Kara tte
lyrics.en: Because we have to see the continuation of the dream
lyrics.zh: 根本就沒有空去入睡

lyrics.ja: 手をひいて走っていった
lyrics.en: You took my hand and ran off
lyrics.zh: 便牽起我的手奔跑起來

lyrics.ja: 「いつかの空、見つけに行こう!」
lyrics.en: "Let me take you to the sky of that moment!"
lyrics.zh: 「去尋找昔日的那片天空吧！」

lyrics.ja: それはきっとあの星のように
lyrics.romaji: Sore ha Kitto Ano Hoshi no You ni
lyrics.en: Surely, like that distant star
lyrics.zh: 那一定就像那一顆星星般

lyrics.ja: 遠く彼方まで光っていて
lyrics.en: Shining bright into the far distance
lyrics.zh: 向著遙遠的彼方綻放光彩

lyrics.ja: いつか君が星を見ていた
lyrics.romaji: Itsuka Kimi ga Hoshi wo MiteIta
lyrics.en: Someday you were gazing at the stars
lyrics.zh: 曾經的你曾凝望著星星

lyrics.ja: 連れていくよ あの時の空へ
lyrics.romaji: TsureteIku yo Ano Toki no Sora he
